feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 27 July 2026 5:01am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 27 July 2026 at 5:00am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure centred near the Azores. Low pressure over the Norwegian Sea, and a new shallow low developing to the south of Iceland later.


##Wind##

West or northwest 4 or 5, backing southwest this afternoon, then decreasing mainly 3 or 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate becoming slight later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair at first, then occasional outbreaks of rain or drizzle developing later this morning especially across the north of the area.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in precipitation.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 3 or 4, increasing 4 or 5 early Tuesday morning, perhaps occasionally 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight becoming slight or moderate Tuesday morning.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or drizzle, particularly in northern to central parts.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor at times in precipitation.
